items.name: flex-auth-service
items.scope: Service xác thực/ủy quyền (.NET): đăng nhập, token, phân quyền, user/role; đang migrate khỏi Oracle sang PostgreSQL

items.name: flex-api-gateway
items.scope: API Gateway (.NET): route, proxy, cấu hình gateway, Dockerfile/Jenkinsfile của gateway

items.name: flex-microfrontend
items.scope: Frontend client (Angular): màn hình, component, form, modal, bảng, SCSS, gọi API từ UI

items.name: flex-environment
items.scope: Stack hạ tầng local/dev (Docker Compose): docker-compose*.yml, service phụ trợ, biến môi trường dev

items.name: flex-agent-service
items.scope: Nền tảng AI Agent đa tenant (.NET 9, SignalR): control plane, runtime, agent, tenant

items.name: flex-database
items.scope: Migration/schema dùng chung (Liquibase SQL-first): PostgreSQL, MySQL tenant, changelog, seed, index, constraint

items.name: flex-exchange-service
items.scope: Lõi khớp lệnh limit in-memory (.NET): order, matching, REST API/Swagger demo

items.name: flex-k8s
items.scope: Manifest Kubernetes thuần (YAML, kubectl): namespace, deployment, service, ingress cho môi trường Flex
